entities.summary: Levan Ioseliani is a Georgian political figure currently serving as the Public Defender of Georgia. Ioseliani was elected to Parliament by party list, bloc: "Aleko Elisashvili – Citizens" and served as the Deputy Speaker from 2021 to 2023.
